conventions.name: production-package-scaffolding
conventions.description: Every production package under packages/ follows the HoBo package layout: a package.json + tsconfig.json alongside src/ (implementation), test/ (tests), contracts/ (PACT boundary contracts), and data-models/ (protobuf + CUE constrained types). See AGENTS.md.

conventions.name: nested-package-scaffolding
conventions.description: Packages nested under a category container (runtimes/, providers/, iac/) follow the same HoBo package layout as top-level packages.
